verdict.summary: The change correctly replaces five text-level, dictionary-per-stratum evaluations with the compiled evaluator while preserving the load-bearing stratum order and carrying each full closure into the next evaluation in one dictionary. Fact ingestion remains fail-closed through intern_facts, rule compilation failures are cached and returned as errors, and extraction consistently uses the shared dictionary. The existing ODRL differential is non-vacuous: it exercises the real materialize_odrl_n3 path, compares against the independent Rust evaluator and explicit expected auth sets, includes deny-overrides and generated fail-closed coverage, and therefore directly gates this seam change. This is consistent with the compiled-rules audit's stratification and scoped-subset requirements.
